reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: getMemberDisplayName and getAllMemberNames are exported 'use server' functions qualifying for public/exported API exception; ensureGenerationRoleExists has internal callers at members.ts:270,441. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; attack vector is unauthenticated public internet. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/ is explicitly in-scope with server action authorization listed as a key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the public login page by extracting server-action IDs from the Next.js JS bundle and POSTing to /_next/server/actions/[hash] without a session cookie, causing full member roster disclosure (Discord UIDs + display names via getAllMemberNames) and unauthorized Discord role creation via ensureGenerationRoleExists. Severity Critical is retained: unauthenticated PII disclosure of the entire member list with no mitigating controls; no client_diversity cap applies.
